:::{#def-finite-additivity}
#### Finite additivity

Let $\salg$ be a [$\sigma$-algebra](#def-sigma-algebra) on a set $S$.
A [function](sets-functions.qmd#def-function) $\mu : \salg \to [0, \infty]$,
with values in the [extended non-negative reals](sets-functions.qmd#def-extended-nonneg-reals),
is **finitely additive**
if, for every finite collection of
[pairwise disjoint](#def-pairwise-disjoint) sets $\dsn{A}$ in $\salg$,
the value of their union is the sum of their values:

$$\mu(A_1 \cup \cdots \cup A_n) = \sumin \mu(A_i)$$

:::
